brief.zh: 没有标签，只有每张图的两个变形版本。训练编码器，让测验里的每个视图都以 ≥ 50% 的概率认出自己的搭档。
brief.en: No labels, only two altered versions of each image. Train the encoder so that every view in the quiz picks out its partner with probability ≥ 50%.

hint.zh: 只拉近搭档，最省事的办法是什么？看看所有点最后去了哪里。
hint.en: If you only pull partners together, what is the laziest way to do it? Watch where all the dots end up.

after.zh: 只拉近正对时，把所有图都放到同一点就能让损失最小，却什么也分不出：这叫坍缩。InfoNCE 的分母把同一批里的其他视图当作负对推开，点才在圆上散开。变形本身提供了答案，不需要人工标签：这就是自监督的对比学习（SimCLR）。
after.en: When only positive pairs are pulled together, putting every image at the same point minimises the loss but tells nothing apart: this is called collapse. InfoNCE's denominator treats the other views in the batch as negative pairs and pushes them away, so the dots spread out round the circle. The alterations themselves supply the answer, with no human labels: this is self-supervised contrastive learning (SimCLR).

t.zh: 前几章的训练都靠标签：每张图配一个人写的答案。可现实里绝大多数照片没有标签，给上百万张图逐一标注又贵又慢。没有答案，还能学吗？
t.en: Training in earlier chapters relied on labels: every image came with an answer written by a person. But in the real world almost no photos have labels, and labelling millions of images one by one is slow and expensive. Can a model still learn without answers?

t.zh: 一个办法：把一张图做成两个变形版本，挪一点、调亮暗、加点噪声。两个版本一定来自同一张图，这件事本身就能当答案用。很多图像模型先这样在大量没标签的图上练过。
t.en: One way: make two altered versions of an image, shifted a little, brighter or darker, with some noise added. The two versions are certain to come from the same image, and that fact alone can serve as the answer. Many image models are first trained like this on huge numbers of unlabelled images.

t.zh: 台上的编码器把每个视图变成一个方向，画成圆上的一个点；同一张图的两个视图连着线，叫一对搭档。测验时，每个视图要在所有点里挑出自己的搭档。
t.en: The encoder on the bench turns each view into a direction, drawn as a point on a circle; the two views of the same image are joined by a line and called a pair of partners. In the quiz, each view has to pick out its own partner from all the points.

t.zh: 损失公式分两项：一项把搭档拉近，一项把同一批里的其他视图推开，第二项可以开关。这一关你要训练编码器。动手前先想：一个好的编码器，点在圆上应该是什么样子？
t.en: The loss has two terms: one pulls partners together, the other pushes away the other views in the same batch, and the second can be switched on or off. In this level you train the encoder. Before you start, think: with a good encoder, what should the points on the circle look like?

label.en: Lowest chance of picking the partner
Mean sim of negative pairs, no collapse
